acceptance: Source capabilities only. Compiled/native/browser parity is carried by separate exact-DLL reports; never infer runtime acceptance from this file.

sensors.meaning: Accelerometer family constant axis bias in m/s^2; explicit zero gives no bias.

seed_rules.environment: Existing nonzero uint64 decimal environment seed is never rewritten.
seed_rules.shardx_explicit: 1..UINT32_MAX; larger explicit mode seed is rejected.
seed_rules.shardx_inherited: Version 1 uses the existing UxrPixelNoiseSeed fold; uint32 inputs unchanged, folded zero becomes one.
seed_rules.companions_without_mode: New mode-seed/amount keys require an explicit corresponding mode.
seed_rules.original_seed_format: Canonical decimal 1..UINT64_MAX; effective leading-zero text is rejected without changing saved values.

identity.native_scope: UA/UA-CH/navigator.platform; preserves other shared platform consumers.

memory.scope: native keeps both surfaces native; custom keeps JS and Client Hints coherent; cloak-original uses the explicit JS-only override while Client Hints stay native.

original.requires: Explicit v2 and an explicit finite positive memory value whose conversion to binary32 stays finite and strictly positive. No nearest-bucket conversion.
original.off: Master off clears persona fields before renderer snapshot; this original getter also explicitly falls back to native when the off marker is set.
original.scope: Window/iframe and WorkerNavigator share the JS mixin; browser/client-hint memory remains the native approximation. Does not change allocator or V8 heap.
original.source_checks: 187 exact getter/admission/source checks with explicit dependency doubles; 25 captured valid realm values checked. This is not new candidate browser acceptance.
original.raw_invalid_difference: Original raw 0/-1/NaN/Infinity returned the seed-selected value8 in this observed seed12345 setup. Product typed configuration rejects these and float overflow/underflow-to-zero; rejection is not an original-output parity pass.
original.value_semantics: The JS getter returns static_cast<float>(value), including nonbucket values. Custom/native/legacy paths and browser Client-Hints approximation remain unchanged.

screen.native_scope: Screen/work-area/orientation/DPR fields; viewport and native window settings remain separate.

hardware_profile.precedence: Explicit caller CPU/RAM/WebGL values and per-field native modes win.
hardware_profile.memory: An explicit empty/native memory field stays native; generated numeric memory uses coherent custom mode.
hardware_profile.gpu_identity: Uses the independent GPU mode; does not turn on legacy compatibility/synthetic pixel or text policies.
hardware_profile.scope: Recorded metadata and deterministic CPU/RAM choices; no physical hardware emulation.

legacy.behavior: Preserved original policy, seeds, helper formulas, Bridge and backend gates

canvas.storage: Owned completed RGBA8/BGRA8 output; original drawing pixels are not mutated
canvas.other_formats: Compatible-v1 remains native for float16/HDR. The explicit cloak-original branch admits only its separately listed typed formats; unhandled formats stay native.
canvas.chromix: Existing uint64 seed fold and absolute-coordinate RGB +/-1 algorithm
canvas.shardx: Byte-verified xoshiro128** 32 assignments over the complete canvas, projected into crops, with the recovered partial-alpha round-trip guard

cloak.core: Byte-verified hash and ten sparse LSB candidates
intentional_differences: Logical RGB bit ordering on both RGBA and BGRA, correcting the original export R/B discrepancy
Choose on the complete canvas and project into cropped readback
Preserve every partial-alpha pixel rather than infer an unverified original arithmetic branch

reference_bank.reason: Observed original reference matching can replace different real colors with identical stored images/pixels
reference_bank.original_mechanism_research: Separate 68-record bank, unique matcher, and false/raw distinctions documented in the research

native_fallback_conditions: Unavailable snapshot or unsuccessful actual read
canvas.existing_policy_scope: Existing mode values retain the compatible-v1 rules below; cloak-original uses graphics.original_pixels.

webgl.production_seed_sequence: ShardX uses zero on every read; no process counter is consumed
webgl.supported_readback: Opaque default framebuffer, in-bounds RGBA/UNSIGNED_BYTE TypedArray, non-shared destination, valid PACK layout, at most 16 MiB staging
webgl.completion_proof: All staging alpha bytes become 255 before any caller output is committed
webgl.errors: Never consume the page GL error queue; failed/incomplete staging does not alter the caller buffer
webgl.shardx_export: Native; the original CPU readPixels algorithm did not affect PNG export
webgl.cloak_export: Logical RGB and top-left full-canvas coordinates agree with the corresponding supported GL readback
webgl.existing_policy_scope: Existing mode values retain the compatible-v1 rules below; cloak-original uses graphics.original_pixels.

export_routing.source: Actual canvas rendering context, classified as Canvas2D/WebGL/Other at the HTML or Offscreen call site
export_routing.transport: Immutable value object through ImageDataBuffer and both CanvasAsyncBlobCreator constructors
export_routing.async_processing: Once-prepared image buffer retained across idle, worker and encoder-thread paths
export_routing.unknown_source: Retain legacy behavior; never guess Canvas2D
export_routing.bridge: New explicit pixel modes bypass that surface's legacy Bridge pixel substitution; unrelated text/Bridge behavior is unchanged

seeds.cloak: Nonzero uint64 serialized as canonical decimal ASCII
seeds.shardx: Effective uint32; explicit values outside 1..UINT32_MAX rejected by the common parser; environment-seed folding is a separately documented launcher v1 rule

original_pixels.selection: On a reference miss, ordinary LSB uses current-read width/height >=8, physical channels, and the separately stated typed/alpha guards.
original_pixels.channels: Physical storage order, preserving original RGBA/BGRA export discrepancy.
original_pixels.byte_alpha: Canvas byte candidates write only when candidate<=alpha; not blanket partial-alpha bypass.
original_pixels.typed_pixels: Finite half16/float32 lowest component byte; skip NaN/Infinity exponent patterns without changing alpha.
original_pixels.canvas_half_guard: Premultiplied float16 stays native, matching the observed original Skia adapter.
webgl_formats: RGBA/HALF_FLOAT when the real context permits it
original_pixels.webgl_framebuffers: Native validated default and user FBO, including transparent reads; complete double-sentinel staging before processing.
original_pixels.webgl_errors: Never read/clear the page GL error queue; mismatched/incomplete stages fall back to native, lost context returns without writes.
original_pixels.pbo: Numeric-offset PBO overload remains native, matching the captured original control.

reference_bank.matching: Three per-context operation streams, seven fields, exact counts/quality, optional stream constraints, unique cumulative export match.
reference_bank.recorder_lifecycle: Each stream clears before append when its prior count is at least 256. Resize/reset/clear do not clear it; dispose/detach does.
reference_bank.payload_family: Mac -> Apple; otherwise ASCII-insensitive renderer recognition before vendor recognition, Intel before NVIDIA including complete model/device-ID pools; fallback H32(seedText+gpu_vendor) low bit.
reference_bank.export_mime: HTML matches original nonempty MIME or PNG for empty input; Offscreen uses native normalized MIME and allows reference replacement only for PNG with quality sentinel -1.
reference_bank.byte_transport: Exact stored data URI or decoded compressed Blob bytes; no re-encoding of reference pixels. Selection is frozen before asynchronous encoding.
reference_bank.priority: Successful reference replacement precedes and bypasses ordinary LSB for that read/export.
reference_bank.noise_controls: false retains references; raw bypasses. Old compatible mode still has its reference bank disabled.
reference_bank.typed_readback: ImageData byte/float16 rows; validated RGBA/U8 WebGL TypedArray row copies preserving pack skip/padding. PBO/shared/over-budget remain native.

original_pixels.noise_controls: false/raw bypass ordinary LSB; reference bank survives false and bypasses raw.
original_pixels.acceptance: Source/goldens are not native browser acceptance. Requires exact compiled DLL paired runtime before launcher enrollment.
original_pixels.opaque_put_image_data: Only canvas cloak-original with master off excluded bypasses the product opaque-alpha sanitation copy and follows existing native PutByteArray for every format. Input crop/destination and other modes retain their existing behavior. Source change requires new-DLL RGBA8/F16 and exported sample acceptance.
original_pixels.text_operation_recorder: Original reference logging occurs in the four public fillText/strokeText wrappers before native paint/font/maxWidth/finite-value drawing checks. Drawing validations still run; internal text-cluster calls do not invent those public operations. Matcher/data are unchanged.

gpu.custom_identity: Complete vendor/renderer or vendor/architecture pairs required; unsupported combinations are rejected.
gpu.webgl_custom_semantics: Clamp real validation caches downward; 3D/array fields apply only to WebGL2. Other numeric enum overrides rejected in this mode.
gpu.webgpu_features_semantics: Subset of real adapter support. Empty custom list has no optional features; real core feature remains.
gpu.webgpu_limits_semantics: Conservative public ceiling, validate requests then forward unchanged to Dawn; no fake device-limit restoration.
gpu.device_info: Retain actual subgroup range and developer visibility; no synthetic device/driver identity.

original_webgpu.profile_required: Known resolved family/index from the preserved catalog; unknown profiles fail admission.
original_webgpu.custom_companions: Original identity rejects explicit custom vendor/architecture/description; original features rejects a custom feature allowlist.
original_webgpu.policy: Recovered public profile identity/features/limits, original request forwarding and public device restoration, independent of compatible intersection/ceiling policy.
original_webgpu.backend: Advertised metadata does not create physical GPU features or capacity. Required-feature failure and resource/shader behavior still depend on Dawn and the real adapter.

webgl_extensions_independent.custom: Requires an explicit allowlist field; empty CSV denies all. Nonempty comma-separated ASCII extension identifiers, optional surrounding ASCII whitespace. Intersection with actual registered support/draft/developer/disabled conditions. Independent of capabilities mode.
webgl_extensions_independent.native: Keeps real support; rejects simultaneous explicit allowlist.
webgl_extensions_independent.original: Independent original shared support selector; rejects simultaneous allowlist.
webgl_extensions_independent.legacy: With extensions-mode omitted, old capabilities-custom/list semantics and version1 argv remain unchanged. Original caps may also use this legacy list route.
webgl_extensions_independent.combinations: Capabilities native/custom/original with explicit extensions custom are all supported. Numeric custom limits conflict only with original capabilities, not with original extensions.

original_webgl.mode_version_notes: New precision/extensions fields require version2 for every explicit value. Existing identity/capabilities native/custom version1 inputs remain valid.
original_webgl.seed: Identity/capabilities require a canonical nonzero uint64 global seed. Precision/extensions do not consume seed. No new per-domain seed or amount fields.
original_webgl.profile: Separate original public WebGL snapshot; CPU/RAM/WebGPU selectors are untouched. Default NVIDIA display index does not redirect0/2. Explicit Windows aliases use ordered matching and only unknown recognized-family fallback uses an empty seed for display. WindowsIntel sample architecture independently uses raw input and the global seed. A display index of-1 represents unknown raw passthrough, not a fabricated GPU model.
original_webgl.identity: Explicit original public vendor/renderer presentation also applies to software contexts; this differs from the old hardware-only identity guard and never attests actual GPU hardware.
original_webgl.renderer_input: Optional bounded nonempty UTF8 renderer text. Exact ANGLE ( prefix passes through. Windows uses Intel-first family recognition, complete ASCII-insensitive device-ID pass then model pass; direct matches includingNVIDIA0/2 are kept. Linux matches case-sensitive NVIDIA device IDs then models and wraps the original raw string. Mac and unknown nonempty neutral names pass through. Product typed empty renderer is rejected; original raw empty renderer uses the native getter, so rejection is not an output parity pass.
original_webgl.capabilities: Recovered GL1/GL2 scalar queries, cached 2D texture/renderbuffer/viewport limits, typed arrays, and original method-specific driver dimension clamps. Real cube-map, vertex-attrib, dynamic framebuffer/state, invalid-enum, lost-context and unhandled query paths retained.
dimensions: texStorage3D TEXTURE_2D_ARRAY width/height and levels only; true3D/depth native
renderbuffer storage and stored width/height presentation
original_webgl.samples: Case-sensitive M5 / Windows Intel gen9 public MAX_SAMPLES and validated internalformat sample lists. Requested samples are clamped only when positive, within advertised max, and above positive native max; the requested count is then retained for the public RBO getter. Requests above advertisement still reach the real backend. Does not prove physical sample count.
original_webgl.precision: LOW/MED FLOAT and INT tuples after native shader/type/lost validation. HIGH remains the actual driver query.
original_webgl.extensions: One selector is consumed by enumeration and getExtension object lookup. Windows allowlist and Apple extra compression objects follow original early decisions. Registered native extension constructors and native driver errors remain; observed Apple compressed upload INVALID_ENUM is not converted to decoder support.
original_webgl.noise: These public policies are independent of noise true/false/raw.
original_webgl.master_off: Product global off remains native. Original binary base/GL2 switch-presence/off behavior differs and is not claimed equivalent.
original_webgl.pixel_reference_independence: No dependence on WebGL pixel or reference-bank gates. Public policy does not certify pixel/reference parity.
pending: Exact-DLL Window/Worker public metadata, alias, resource/error and translated diagnostic acceptance

translated_shader_diagnostics.scope: Recovered public diagnostic HLSL/Metal string generation from GLSL text. Existing explicit disable-translated-shaders, context loss and shader-object validation retain priority. Linux and other modes use real native GLStringQuery. This does not compile/execute HLSL/Metal or add backend capabilities.

media_counts.policy: Upper bounds on actually enumerated devices, preserving native IDs, permission labels and selected capabilities.
media_counts.not_provided: Virtual capture backend or enforcement of hidden IDs in all getUserMedia selectors.

real_audio_controls.sample_rate_scope: Only the default realtime AudioContext rate when its constructor omits sampleRate. Uses native rendering/resampling and AudioWorklet rate; explicit AudioContext, OfflineAudioContext and AudioBuffer options retain precedence.
real_audio_controls.channel_scope: Cap the real destination capacity and validate actual channel changes. Default channels create the corresponding output bus; never expand physical capacity.
real_audio_controls.unsupported_default_channels: An explicitly configured initial count beyond the real/capped destination capacity raises NotSupportedError on context creation.
real_audio_controls.absent: Keep the original native defaults and all existing audio modes.
real_audio_controls.not_provided: Physical device replacement, arbitrary DSP emulation, capture-track settings rewriting.

font_allowlists.format: UTF-8 comma-separated actual family names, ASCII case-insensitive, whitespace trimmed; no escaped commas.
font_allowlists.general_scope: Resolved native CSS families, local() and Local Font Access; intersects the selected font strategy.
font_allowlists.local_scope: Additional restriction for local() and Local Font Access, without changing ordinary CSS family access.
font_allowlists.absent: No additional restriction; preserve the prior branch.
font_allowlists.explicit_empty: Deny local families within that list's scope, with safe empty-glyph last resort.
font_allowlists.intentional_difference: Does not reproduce original nonexistent-name aliases or assert that missing font files exist. Downloaded web fonts remain separate.

webgl_masked_identity.requires: Both values plus a complete custom WebGL identity; maximum 512 UTF-8 bytes each.
webgl_masked_identity.scope: GL_VENDOR/GL_RENDERER display values for eligible actual hardware contexts, independent of unmasked strings.
webgl_masked_identity.software_fallback: Keep native standard WebKit/WebKit WebGL values when actual identity override is ineligible.

unimplemented_original_surfaces: Uncaptured font assets and complete cross-platform native glyph equivalence.
General Mac DSP emulation and arbitrary WebAudio graph/automation/GC equivalence beyond the observed reference gate.
Gyroscope/orientation/refresh scheduling mechanisms without established evidence.
Virtual capture backends, synthetic device identities and complete cross-platform codec/DRM policy.
All remaining reference-bank overload/lifecycle/invalid-input cases and packed/integer/HDR formats; PBO stays native by the captured design.

surface_differences.change: Hash/filter the canonical resolved native family rather than caller spelling; src:local and CSS case variants cannot bypass the same family. Local Font Access uses the same family filter. Preserve mandatory last-resort fallback.
surface_differences.original_preserved: Original FNV/protected-name math retained and verified independently; no change to legacy/Chromix paths.

surface_differences.change: Use recovered Windows 30/138/149/231/232 buckets and Mac562/Linux47 candidate arrays at resolved-family lookup. Preserve native generic and glyph/last-resort fallback; no nonexistent typeface assets or undocumented alias mapping.
surface_differences.limits: Candidate count is not an installed/enumerable font count. Original coverage gates and full alias substitution are deliberately not reproduced.

surface_differences.change: Analyser transforms only the native written prefix, preserving caller suffix. AudioBuffer copyFrom first performs the native overlap-safe copy then transforms only the copied destination prefix, avoiding source-alias writes into caller tails. copyTo only transforms its native destination write range; getChannelData retains the measured shared-PCM fixed-point rule.
surface_differences.original_preserved: Float mantissa and byte LSB formulas/salts unchanged; graph isolation remains the separate old Chromix path.

surface_differences.change: Mac persona + mono +44100Hz + complete bitwise native PCM match to one of three captured source buffers before reference replacement at completion.
surface_differences.limits: Not general Mac DSP. Reject double destination, stereo, other rates, decoy/unconnected compressor output, altered/unknown samples. No guessed native counter or object-only match. Both false/raw retain this selected reference policy.

surface_differences.change: Exact font/text key plus matching host/persona, requested/resolved family, every shaped glyph's family, native width and actual glyph bounding metrics required before reference font/baseline correction.
surface_differences.limits: Generic/substituted/mixed fallback faces and mismatched geometry retain the shaped native result. Font file identity/version is not established by the vendor tables; this is a bounded coherence guard, not proof of identical source fonts.

surface_differences.change: Only Accelerometer/LinearAccelerationSensor/GravitySensor; shared parser defaults new Auto amount to0.1m/s². Explicit0 remains no bias; legacy defaults unchanged.
surface_differences.limits: No sensor fabrication, gyro/orientation/event rewriting, or Android hardware claim.

surface_differences.change: Three independent0..32 caps on browser-filtered enumeration entries; missing cap means unlimited. Preserve native IDs, labels, permission filtering, aliases and capability indices. Never add fake devices.
surface_differences.limits: Enumeration entries include native default/communications aliases. This does not disable capture by an already known native ID or alter actual capture backends/devicechange.

surface_differences.change: Reference pool/locale supplies candidate order. Select only existing native entries by exact name and ASCII-case-insensitive language; move original VoicePtr entries, preserving URI, localService and default fields. SAPI=false removes actual local entries, including entries that the reference table labels remote.
surface_differences.limits: The intersection can be empty. No missing Mac/Google/SAPI engine or voice is fabricated; actual synthesis remains native and is not exercised by these metadata tests.

surface_activation_scope.text_cloak: false preserves references; raw bypasses; strict glyph guard additionally applies.
surface_activation_scope.offset_cloak: Explicit mode is the v1 opt-in; false/raw bypass; fixed >50 and hash%81-30 algorithm; no amplitude scaling.
surface_activation_scope.audio_cloak: Selected mode and actual-buffer eligibility; false/raw do not override this independent policy.
surface_activation_scope.fonts_cloak: Candidate selection remains independent of noise false/raw, matching identity-selection separation.
surface_activation_scope.text_cloak_original: Exact reference selector; false retains, raw bypasses; compatible glyph guards remain only on cloak.
surface_activation_scope.audio_cloak_original: Recovered graph gate and completion-time counter; false/raw retain.
surface_activation_scope.voices_cloak_original: Full reference metadata inventory; actual synthesis is native.

voice_scope: cloak retains native inventory intersection; cloak-original assembles full reference metadata. Neither policy installs missing speech engines.

unsupported_modes.rects/cloak: No confirmed independent Cloak DOMRect numeric mechanism.
unsupported_modes.media/cloak: Original empty-list fake input has no capture backend; deliberately omitted rather than add a no-op mode.
unsupported_modes.voices/shardx: No separately established strategy in the audited target.

data_policy: Compiled decoded reference output bytes and numeric/string metadata only. No opaque ciphertext, licensing material, keys or remote runtime data loading.

configuration_versions.2: Explicit original surfaces, separate WebGPU/public-WebGL policies and independent WebGL extension filtering. Existing version1 values retain their previous behavior.

original_strategy_contract.seed_input_scope: Used canvas/webgl/fonts effective seeds must be canonical nonzero uint64 decimal; leading-zero spellings are rejected, never rewritten. Existing v1/compatible seed admission is unchanged. Original public WebGL identity/capabilities global seed is likewise canonical; no silent rewriting.
original_strategy_contract.global_hardware_seed_scope: The pre-existing hardware-profile API is unchanged; noncanonical raw seed spelling parity is not claimed.
original_strategy_contract.global_off_scope: Preserved all-native master-off semantics. The original target still returns its voice metadata on master off; that is a declared difference, not a parity pass. Original WebGL GL2 presence gates also differ; product global off stays native.
original_strategy_contract.build_time_runtime_scope: The existing 25-group compatible runtime matrix does not establish acceptance for these new original consumers.
original_strategy_contract.source_revision: Observed public WebGL, diagnostic/alias consumers, original caller/opaque-memory/font fixes; existing version1 algorithms remain unchanged.

text.selection: Exact serialized font/text key, positive native width for nonempty text; Mac normalization follows the captured original key rule.
text.effect: Nine stored metrics with corresponding em height and baselines; no glyph rendering or font installation.
text.source_call_path: The original branch is dispatched from measureText with the serialized font getter; native/compatible/shard call paths retain their previous selection.

voices.selection: Full captured reference metadata pool by persona/locale/SAPI option at the native voices notification boundary.
voices.effect: Returned voice name/URI/language/local/default metadata; actual synthesis engines remain native.
voices.limits: Metadata parity is not proof that an advertised voice can synthesize on this machine.
voices.lifecycle: Original target begins empty and populates at the native notification boundary; cached object identity is retained. Candidate timing/identity remains separately required.
voices.global_off_difference: Original off returns the actual three local zh-CN voices plus 19 Google entries in the observed host; Windows persona instead selects three en-US reference locals plus 19 Google entries. This kernel preserves existing all-native master off (three actual locals here), not either 22-entry inventory.

original_audio.selection: First successfully created oscillator and first compressor retained by node factories, including new Node(options); current values sampled once at startRendering.
original_audio.counter: uint32 increment on each newly inserted output-to-context-destination connection, duplicates skipped; disconnect never decrements. Completion reads current counter.
original_audio.platform: Mac persona only; other personas retain native PCM.
original_audio.common_gate: Both first nodes exist; oscillator is triangle.
original_audio.short_gate: 1000 frames requires mono/44100/count=1 and exact float parameters 9998.123/-52/40/12/0.0001/0.25.
original_audio.other_gate: Float AudioParam getters promoted to double; each difference from 10000/-50/40/12/0/0.25 must be <= double 0.001.
original_audio.effect: Replace only returned channel 0 at completion. Other channels, analyser data and processing graph remain native.
original_audio.noise_controls: false/raw do not suppress this selected reference policy; seed is unused.
original_audio.compatible_mode_unchanged: cloak retains strict full native PCM matching and mono/44100 guards.
original_audio.timing_limit: Unsynchronized post-start mutation tests do not require native waveform equality across runs.

original_fonts.seed: Uses fonts policy seed for H(canonical decimal seed+font_population); optional per-field override is a manager extension, omission follows original global seed selection.
original_fonts.implementation: Captured coverage/requested-family candidate and alias/remap policy; actual font lookup/assets and last-resort fallback remain native.
original_fonts.local_scope: CSS and FontFace src:local resolution; Local Font Access permission/enumeration remains separate.
limits: Native Mac/Linux host builds not investigated
Actual host font counts not recovered; threshold flags only
Exact 54/72 thresholds lack distinct positive real-font samples
Missing assets and shared fallback do not count as successful parity
original_fonts.generic_selection: Original-only FontSelector availability checks prefer Windows monospace Consolas and math Cambria Math; Mac standard/body/serif/sans/cursive/fantasy use recovered preferred families only when actually available. Quoted/generic guards, script settings and native fallback remain.
original_fonts.mac_family_alias: On non-native-Mac builds, fonts-original Mac persona converts exact CSSFontFamilyValue BlinkMacSystemFont to system-ui while preserving family-name kind, serialization quotes and list order. Native Mac compilation keeps its original platform branch; TextMetrics-only selection does not enable this.

native_source_checks.qualification: Pure/source tests only; exact-DLL browser parity remains a separate required report.

language_controls.shape: 1..32 ordered ASCII BCP47 tag strings, each at most255 bytes. Typed empty/invalid tags, und primary, canonical duplicates and conflicting raw uxr-languages/accept-lang inputs are rejected at save and launch. Existing raw normalization is unchanged.
language_controls.existing_consumer: CSV canonicalization/dedup, accept-lang propagation and renderer ICU first language already exist; no new C++ flag/consumer is introduced.
language_controls.scalar_locale: An explicit scalar locale retains the existing app lang/public fingerprint-locale relationship. Without a scalar locale the new list does not add --lang or public fingerprint-locale.
language_controls.automation: New typed languages path omits Playwright locale override so CDP does not collapse the list; the absent-field legacy path is unchanged.
language_controls.pending: Exact-DLL acceptance of the new typed save/compile/automation path remains required. The existing native consumer observations do not certify that new product chain.
language_controls.header_semantics: Chromium builds Accept-Language from the list, including base-language expansion and q weights; the header is not a verbatim CSV copy. Observed fr-FR,en-US produces fr-FR,fr;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7.
language_controls.native_consumer_observations: Existing387: two controlled lists across Window,iframe,dedicated/shared/service Worker (10realms), keeping scalar app/public localeen-US. JS language and Intl follow the first list tag, navigator.languages retains the list, and actual HTTP follows Chromium expansion. This does not certify the new typed save/compile/Playwright path.
language_controls.voice_locale: The list adds no voice-locale derivation. An explicit scalar keeps the existing voice locale; without a scalar the compatible/original Cloak voice policies retain their existing en-US default. Native voices keep their existing path. No voiceOptions.locale capability is introduced.
